Chapter 439 - 439 Platinum Packets; Open!

Chapter 439 - 439 Platinum Packets; Open!

439 Platinum Packets; Open!

The next day.

The weather was clear.

Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly.

At this moment, he was the only one on the bed. His pillow was filled with a delicate fragrance.

Lin Fan picked up his phone, and a message appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 35,790,120 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Although the money he earned from breathing, walking, and sleeping every day was five times more than before, reaching a total of 35.79 million, Lin Fan did not feel anything.

He focused his attention on the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

Lin Fan could not help but yawn. He scrolled through his phone for a while.

Only then did he slowly get up.

When Lin Fan opened the door, he was greeted by the fragrance of food.

He could not help but walk toward the dining room.

There were pork ribs, yam and red date soup, fried dumplings, and fried eggs on the dining table.

Hu Tian, who was still busy in the kitchen, slowly walked out.

When she saw Lin Fan, she smiled and said, “Are you hungry? Eat something first.”

“Alright!” Lin Fan said.

It had to be said that Hu Tian’s culinary skills were indeed not bad.

Even Lin Fan, who was a master chef, could not help but praise the food and eat everything.

As it was the weekend, they took the time to rest.

Lin Fan and Hu Tian held hands and strolled around outside sweetly.

…

While they were strolling around, the first prosthetic limb was successfully sold for two million yuan under Lil White’s arrangement!

When everyone saw the excellent effect of the prosthetic limb, it immediately caused a huge sensation.

As a result, the price of prosthetic limbs began to rise.

The price of the second prosthetic limb became five million yuan.

The price of the third prosthetic limb was ten million yuan!

The fourth prosthetic limb was priced at 12 million yuan!

…

The magical prosthetic limbs quickly attracted the attention of Hua Nation’s officials.

Therefore, the Hua Nation government also spent a lot of money to buy a prosthetic leg and quickly sent it to the Institute of Science.

The academicians gathered together and let out a wave of enthusiastic praises and discussions.

“How was this artificial limb made?”

“This liquid can actually completely match and connect with the nerves and tendons. It’s simply unbelievable!”

“It’s as if a disabled person has grown a new limb!”

“Amazing! The person who developed it is definitely a genius, an amazing genius!”

“Who developed this?”

“This is unbelievable!”

In fact…

They were not the only ones who were puzzled. Many medical researchers and big investors, both domestic and foreign, were also very interested in these prosthetic limbs.

They first appeared in Hua Nation.

In addition, the Hua Nation government had absolute control over the country.

Soon, they discovered the company that produced the prosthetic limbs. It was called Qinqin Toy Factory.

When they saw the company’s name, the Hua Nation officials thought they were seeing things.

A toy factory… produced such magical prosthetic limbs?

Was this a joke?

With a puzzled attitude, they investigated Qinqin Toy Factory.

Only then did they realize that they had recently applied for the production and sales qualifications of medical equipment.

Furthermore, the legal representative had been changed to Lin Fan!

…

In the blink of an eye, another day passed.

Lin Fan and Hu Tian were lovey-dovey the entire day yesterday.

This morning, Hu Tian received a call. After breakfast, she went to school to settle some matters.

Meanwhile, Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

As he was bored, he picked up his phone and prepared to play with it.

At this moment, he saw the 200,000 red packets displayed on the screen.

Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat as he muttered, “I’ve been out for the past two days and haven’t opened these 200,000 red packets and five platinum packets.

“Now I can open them and see what I can get.”

At this point, Lin Fan’s tone was filled with anticipation.

After all, he had never opened a platinum packet before.

The 200,000 red packets were also a number that he had never accumulated before.

“Open the platinum packets!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’re now the founder of the Qing Hong Sect.]

When Lin Fan caught sight of this, he could not help but reveal a doubtful look.

What was this?

[The Qing Hong Sect: The Qing Hong Sect, once the largest sect, is now the largest financial group in the world. Its headquarters are located in America! With this identity, you can show your nobility! You’ll be even more charming!]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but click his tongue.

Then, Lin Fan opened another platinum packet.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 80 million yuan.]

80 million yuan?

How could a platinum packet give out such trash?

Lin Fan shook his head helplessly and continued to open the platinum packets.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 90 million yuan.]

Trash again!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Plant Growth Water.]

Plants Growth Water.

What was this?

Lin Fan was puzzled as he focused his attention on it.

[Plant Growth Water: A magical potion that allows plants to grow rapidly after being used.]

Make plants grow faster?

It did not seem to be of much use.

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the last platinum packet.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a dust jacket.]

No way!

Just this?

[Dust jacket: After wearing it, your clothes and body will no longer be stained with dirt. At the same time, it has the function of preventing fire and water. Dustless and clean, full of charm!]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up. This was pretty good.

[Do you want to take out the dust jacket?]

“Yes!”

The next moment, a white robe that was as thin as a strand of hair appeared in front of Lin Fan.

He wore it with curiosity.

In the next moment, the white clothes melted into his original clothes like water.

Lin Fan could not help but click his tongue. “As expected of the system! Amazing!”

Then, Lin Fan placed his attention on the 200,000 normal red packets.

At this moment, his phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was the director of the Institute of Science, Feng Zhixiang.

“Professor Lin, you invented prosthetic limbs again?!”

As soon as he picked up the call, an excited shout sounded from the other end.

Lin Fan rubbed his ears and said, “Again? This should be the first time I created a prosthetic limb, right?”

“It’s really you,! You’re really amazing!” Feng Zhixiang shouted again.

Although he had already received the report from the relevant departments about Qinqin Toy Factory, after receiving Lin Fan’s affirmation, he could not help but feel extremely excited.

“Director Feng, don’t be too agitated. Be careful of your health,” Lin Fan reminded him.

After all, Feng Zhixiang was considered an old man.

Great sorrow and joy were taboo. What if something bad happened to him?

Lin Fan would feel a little guilty.
